title: Remove Persona reconciliation mutations from ReadSurfacePorts
summary_zh: 將 Persona provisioning reconciliation 的所有寫入從 ReadSurfacePorts 移至明確的 Persona write-owner command port；保留 terminal ledger、補償、cron cleanup 與 BFF overlay 行為。

owned: authoritative Persona write-owner delegation for terminal and in-flight reconciliation projections
regression coverage for the deployed ReadSurfacePorts update_persona warning
not_changing: Persona service lifecycle transition policy and governance authority
composes_with: post-merge Pantheon dev FE/BFF hosted acceptance

contracts.read_write_boundary: ReadSurfacePorts exposes no create_persona or update_persona compatibility delegation. Both main.py and the extracted personas/service.py reconciliation paths persist only through PersonaProvisioningReconciliationMutationPort backed by the authoritative Persona write owner.
contracts.terminal_durability: paper_running and provisioning_failed reconciliation projections carry their state and metadata to the write owner, while the durable provisioning ledger remains the terminal decision source.
contracts.preserved_behaviour: The change leaves lifecycle policy, compensation, required cron cleanup, authoritative runtime readback, and BFF overlay updates in their existing owners and execution order.
contracts.failure_signature: The deployed warning being repaired is: ReadSurfacePorts object has no attribute update_persona. The new regression invokes reconciliation against a real read-only ReadSurfacePorts instance and asserts the signature is absent.

verification.details: The new read-surface regression suite passed 3/3. Existing authoritative provisioning readback coverage passed 52/52. The broader Persona router suite passed 39 tests and has 2 unrelated baseline failures in quarterly-ranking and promotion-review handlers: both raise NameError for _human_inbox_trusted_promotion_submission, a symbol absent from services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py before this task anchor and outside this task's diff.

checks: BFF startup and reconciliation logs do not contain the ReadSurfacePorts update_persona warning
Persona detail and workshop proof expose the terminal provisioning projection after an authoritative readback
the accepted FE/BFF deployment manifest identifies the exact merged task head

review_handoff.exact_pr_head_authority: The governed ai-status handoff freezes REVIEW_PR, REVIEW_HEAD_SHA, this committed manifest path, and its blob identity. The canonical binding is authoritative because this manifest cannot self-reference the commit that contains it.
